questions.stem: A 10-year-old male child presents with easy fatigability and jaundice for the last 1 month. had similar episodes in the past. On examination, he is found to have splenomegaly. MCHC is 44 g/dl. On ultrasound examination, he is found to have gallstones. Which of the following statements is false regarding this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Severe forms are inherited in an autosomal recessive manner

options.label: B
options.text: ANK-1 mutations account for the majority of this condition

options.label: C
options.text: SLC2A1 mutations are associated with ovalocytosis and cause cardiovascular severe complications

options.label: D
options.text: All the above statements are true
